title: Statistics, B.S. (Eberly College of Science)
notes: Built from the archived 2023-2024 bulletin (https://bulletins.psu.edu/archive/2023-2024/undergraduate/colleges/eberly-science/statistics-bs/), fetched directly. Suggested Academic Plan course-by-semester sequence and prescribed-course list match the 2026 edition course-for-course (same Year 1-4 Fall/Spring placements as STAT-2024.json). Same two real, verified differences as the 2024 edition (confirmed by fetching this year's archive page directly rather than assuming continuity): (1) the 'Select 12 credits from the following' Advanced elective pool includes 'RM 415 Modeling for Actuarial Science' and 'RM 420 Property, Casualty, and Health Insurance' alongside every option 2026 still has -- added both to this file's 4 shared-option-pool 'Advanced STAT/CMPSC elective' slots and RM to the departments list, same as STAT-2024.json. (2) 'Supporting Courses and Related Areas' reads 'Select 9 credits from department list', not 8 -- modeled as 3 open_elective slots of 3 credits each (9 total) instead of 2026's 3+3+2 split. Same MATH 3 -> MATH 4 -> MATH 21 -> STAT 200/STAT 184 prereq-chain fix as STAT-2026.json applied here too, for the same reason given in STAT-2024.json's notes: Backend/catalogs/stat_catalog.json is a single file shared by every catalog-year plan, so the real literal MATH 21 prereq on STAT 200/184 applies here identically regardless of catalog_year.

Advanced STAT/CMPSC elective (department list) -- pick 1 of 4
items.notes: Wired 2026-09 per the archived 2023-2024 bulletin's real, fully-enumerated Statistics and Computing Option 'Select 12 credits from the following' list, quoted verbatim from the archive page: BBH/HPA 440 (Principles of Epidemiology), CMPSC 448 (Machine Learning and Algorithmic AI), IE 434 (Statistical Quality Control), IE 436 (Six Sigma Methodology), MATH 436 (Linear Algebra) or MATH 441 (Matrix Algebra), MATH/CMPSC 451 (Numerical Computations) or MATH/CMPSC 455 (Introduction to Numerical Analysis I), RM 415 (Modeling for Actuarial Science), RM 420 (Property, Casualty, and Health Insurance), STAT/MATH 416 (Stochastic Modeling), STAT 440 (Computational Statistics), STAT 463 (Applied Time Series Analysis), STAT 464 (Applied Nonparametric Statistics), STAT 466 (Survey Sampling). RM 415/420 are real 2023 options that the 2026 edition's own pool no longer lists (see STAT-2026.json's notes) -- added here for historical accuracy; both exist in Backend/catalogs/rm_catalog.json, same caveat about their own actuarial prereq chain as noted in STAT-2024.json.
